goal: Das reale I172-Chromium- und Screenshot-Gate autonom im vorhandenen PR-Workflow ausfuehren und Evidence hochladen.

guide_delta.summary: Der Pull-Request-Workflow fuehrt das unveraenderte I172-Browser-Gate autonom aus und laedt echte Screenshot-Evidence hoch; ohne Browser oder gruenen Nachweis bleibt der Lauf rot.

direct_dependencies: unchanged I172 CDP and screenshot harness
tests_required: compile I174 CI contract and I172 wrapper
real I172 Chromium screenshot and accessibility gate on the PR runner
tests_explicitly_not_run: real Chromium gate cannot run in the local container because no browser binary exists
product tests because runtime product code is unchanged
storage deep gate because repository and schema are unchanged
full suite because the change is limited to browser CI routing
risks: the selected ubuntu-latest runner may not expose a compatible Chrome executable
a real rendering or accessibility defect may turn the PR gate red
shared PYTHONPATH handling must preserve all existing manifest tests
non_changes: no product runtime or UI change
no change to I172 gate assertions or screenshot criteria
no browser binary or archive committed
no new Python, Node or workflow action dependency
no README, TODO or roadmap progress change before remote evidence
no persistence, repository or schema change
expected_side_effects: pull requests execute the real I172 Chromium gate as a targeted manifest test
runtime iteration evidence is uploaded even when the browser gate fails
A-M product progress remains 42 of 132 until remote evidence is green
